component.name: Tern
component.summary: One-Click VPN and network drives for UniFi Identity

description.p: Tern is an unofficial, GNOME-native client for UniFi Identity ("UniFi Endpoint"). Sign in with your organization using your browser (passkeys and single sign-on supported), turn on the One-Click VPN, and auto-mount your UniFi Drive shares — whether you're on the local network or connected remotely over the VPN.
